summary: Rapid Micro Biosystems filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a direct offering of 71,607 shares of Class A common stock at $1.955 per share, along with Series A warrants (exercisable at $1.955 for one year) and Series B warrants (exercisable at $2.34 for five years), sold directly to directors and officers without an underwriter. The offering is contingent on a concurrent underwritten offering of 3,581,000 shares plus warrants via TD Securities and Lake Street Capital Markets, expected to close May 20, 2026. Proceeds are ~$140,000 before expenses. The filing is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
